prose: Orchestrator step 3, group A first half, 2026-11-13: bin/proofs/test_superclaude_is_never_refused_by_the_floor.py names its negative fixture UNCREATABLE = /proc/cairn-no-such-dir/venv and asserts it does not exist before any case leans on its absence. On Windows /proc is the directory C:\proc, and a mkdir -p from an earlier run created C:\proc\cairn-no-such-dir (dated 2026-10-28), so the guard reds with 'exists' and every case below it would pass vacuously. It is a fixture bug, not a missing API: /proc refuses mkdir only on Linux. A path beneath a regular file refuses mkdir on both hosts (NotADirectoryError), so it is the portable uncreatable path.
